legend: Partial infiltration of the tonsil by a lymphoma with a diffuse and follicular growth pattern (<<29583>>). High magnification shows sheets of tumour with centroblastic large cell morphology (<<29594>>) and blastoid large cell morphology with smaller nucleoli (<<29595>>).
Partial infiltration of the tonsil by the lymphoma with strong IRF4 (MUM1) expression.

Strong IRF4 (MUM1) expression in the follicular and diffuse growth tumour components (<<29587>>). BCL6 is positive in reactive and neoplastic follicles and within the diffuse component (<<29588>>). The neoplastic follicles and the diffuse component express BCL2, while reactive germinal centres remain negative (<<29589>>). CD10 is strongly expressed in reactive germinal centres and shows weak expression within the lymphoma (<<29590>>). The lymphoma cells show coexpression of CD5 (<<29592>>).
